newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products steady, but fuel oil up $1.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady, but fuel oil up $1.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady on Thursday, except fuel oil barges which added $1 a tonne, dealers said.
Eurograde gasoline was still quoted in the range $188/$189 fob Rotterdam. One barge traded early at $188 fob Rotterdam, from a trader to a major, repeating Wednesday's early deal.
Heating oil barges were barely changed as IPE August gas oil futures moved within a 50-cent range of Wednesday's close.
Offers held at IPE August +$1.50 fob Rotterdam for prompt and first half August delivery. Buyers still proved hard to find with the dollar still nestling just below 1.80 marks.
Traders said this week's loading delays at one Rotterdam refinery appeared to be clearing.
High sulphur fuel oil barges traded at $88.50 fob Antwerp and fob Rotterdam. Late morning talk was at $88/$89.
Dealers said a trading house provided the lowest offer, of $88, for lower grade storage material. Demand for all grades was thin and bunker enquiries were slow to emerge.
